scope: Claude API standard global on-demand list prices; no cache, batch, regional or infrastructure adjustments
estimate_method: Sum actual reported input_tokens times input unit price plus output_tokens times output unit price across every scored trial in a cell, including failed attempts; divide by successful scored trials. Tool-result tokens are measured but never sent back to the one-turn model, so they are not billed as generation output or next-turn input. Unscored boundary trials are reported separately and excluded from success-rate and cost cells.
